hooks.command:
jq -n "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:"xBill conventions (CLAUDE.md > Start here is authoritative):
1. AUDIT_REPORT.md is the single source for findings - one row per defect: ID, file, issue, status, fix. Do not restate findings elsewhere.
2. diagnostics/README.md is the ONLY README under diagnostics/. Dated folders hold raw evidence only; append a row to the index.
3. Check the trap index in CLAUDE.md before touching Activity/notifications or payment-handle code. Each row cost a real debugging cycle.
4. Never claim device or lifecycle behaviour from a green test suite. App Lock, Face ID, real app switches and push are not reachable from tests - build, install on device, have the user reproduce, pull the log.
5. Finish with: run scripts/run-coverage.sh unit, update CLAUDE.md File Map + Key Patterns, update AUDIT_REPORT.md, commit and push.
6. If a previous agent broke one of these, consolidate rather than extend."}}"

jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // \"\"" | { read -r f; case "$f" in */diagnostics/*/README.md) printf "%s" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"diagnostics/ has exactly one README: diagnostics/README.md. Dated folders hold raw evidence only. Append a row to the index instead, and put findings in AUDIT_REPORT.md. See CLAUDE.md > Start here.\"}}" ;; esac; }
